constraints.specification: The text contains >= 2 clauses predicating benevolent/charitable/pedagogical verbs (the domain's institutional vocabulary: accogliere, soccorrere, mettere in sicurezza, ...) of actions the context marks as coercive or predatory, with NO narratorial correction or evaluative comment. constraints.property: Mare duality — alternating contraction/dilation lexicon, full arc
constraints.specification: Lexical fields alternate over the single referent 'il mare': dilation (mare aperto, alto mare, distendersi, allargarsi, acque libere/internazionali, orizzonte, golfi, seni) vs contraction (stretto, canale, braccio di mare, ristringersi, rotta, corridoio, zona SAR, acque territoriali). The passage runs the full arc dilation -> contraction -> re-dilation. Verifiable by tagging each occurrence against the two word lists and checking the arc order.

The text contains >= 1 pivot sentence in which the same water changes juridical name/state across an invisible boundary, on the model of 'il lago cessa, e l'Adda rincomincia' (e.g. acque internazionali -> zona SAR -> acque territoriali), the boundary made perceptible only by an external marker (chart, coordinates). Verifiable by locating the cessation/recommencement predicates.

constraints.property: Specular doubling on a single head
constraints.specification: The text contains >= 1 syntactic frame with paired predications on one landscape element: a direct-perception predicate and a reflection/representation predicate with an inversion or transformation marker (optical: the horizon doubling sea and sky; or institutional: radar track / footage returning the scene transfigured), with the mirror named in the text. constraints.property: Lucid waviness (ondeggiamento) at the SYNTACTIC level — GLOBAL constraint
constraints.specification: Sustained across the entire passage: the periodic syntax UNDULATES rather than merely winds — successive waves of expansion and contraction, with clause groups swelling (in length and embedding depth) and subsiding in alternation: >= 2 full crest-trough cycles within the longest period, and >= 1 period of >= 8 clauses — while hierarchy stays fully legible: no anacoluthon, exact lexicon, recoverable syntactic tree. The syntactic shape adheres to the target referent: the sea's wave-motion, not the river's meander. Verifiable by segmenting periods into clauses, plotting unit length/depth alternation, and parsing for legibility. (Same figure as C-P7-02, one level down.)

constraints.specification: The text contains 'ondeggiamento' (or a form of 'ondeggiare') placed so that it (i) denotes the waves' movement, (ii) reads as a description of the prose's own undulating syntax (the C-P7-01 waviness, named from within), and (iii) functions as a proleptic marker: the syntactic waviness prefigures the diegetic waviness — the to-and-fro of the crossing and of the migrants' fate that the ensuing narrative will unfold (cf.
